findings.summary: Baseline/adaptive comparison is hard-gated on same scenario id, prompt text/hash, host/runtime/build, method, debug setting, tokenizer/accounting scope, isolation mode, and comparable host context.

Trace schema requires input/output/total token counts, quality score/delta/regression fields, privacy/redaction status, correlation id, created timestamp, raw private input/output refs, and redacted input/output refs.
Plan requires at least three runs for variable hosts, median/min/max/stddev/outlier reporting, and an inconclusive result when only single-run or overlapping-variance evidence exists.
Adaptive quality regression produces FAIL_QUALITY_REGRESSION even when token counts decrease.
Token delta alone cannot prove runtime readiness, quality improvement, semantic quality, model readiness, target promotion, rollback, or learnability.
